title: Touvigation: Embodied Adaptive Object Acquisition for Blind and Low-Vision Users in Unfamiliar Indoor Environments
abstract: arXiv:2609.21828v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Blind and low-vision users often face challenges when locating and physically acquiring objects in unfamiliar indoor environments. Existing vision-language-model-based assistants can provide semantic descriptions but may introduce latency, hallucinations, and guidance that is poorly aligned with embodied action. We present Touvigation, a hands-free object acquisition system that combines vision-language understanding with persistent local spatial modeling to provide low-latency, body-relative guidance. Drawing on formative interviews with eight blind and low-vision participants, we design a multi-stage guidance framework that adapts spatial references as users transition from orienting, to walking, to reaching and tactile verification. We evaluated Touvigation with 12 blind and low-vision participants against a multimodal large-language-model assistant and unassisted search. translated_title: Touvigation：面向盲人与低视力用户在陌生室内环境中的具身自适应物体获取系统
translated_abstract: 盲人与低视力用户在陌生室内环境中定位并实际获取物体时常常面临挑战。现有的基于视觉-语言模型的助手虽然能够提供语义描述，但可能引入延迟、幻觉，以及与具身行动难以匹配的引导。我们提出了Touvigation，一个免手操作的物体获取系统，它将视觉-语言理解与持久性局部空间建模相结合，以提供低延迟的、以身体为参照的引导。基于对八名盲人与低视力参与者的形成性访谈，我们设计了一个多阶段引导框架，能够随着用户从定向、行走、伸手到触觉验证的过渡而自适应地调整空间参照。我们与12名盲人和低视力参与者一起评估了Touvigation，并将其与多模态大语言模型助手和无辅助搜索进行了对比。Touvigation实现了100%的任务成功率，相比之下（摘要在此处截断）为58%。
tldr: Touvigation是一个面向盲人与低视力用户的免手操作物体获取系统，通过将视觉-语言理解与持久性局部空间建模相结合，并随用户从定向、行走、伸手到触觉验证的阶段转换自适应调整空间引导，在12名参与者的评估中实现了100%的任务成功率。
en_tdlr: Touvigation is a hands-free object acquisition system for blind and low-vision users that combines vision-language understanding with persistent local spatial modeling, adaptively adjusting body-relative guidance across orienting, walking, reaching, and tactile verification stages, achieving 100% task success in evaluations with 12 participants.
